correctness.rationale: For every finite tree, B is injective over characteristic 2, im(B)=even-sum hyperplane, ker B^T=<1>; M=B^TB therefore has nullity zero for odd n and exactly one for even n. Sylvester and rooted matrix-forest determinant express the characteristic polynomial mod 2 as sum over odd-order-component forests, establishing an odd zero algebraic multiplicity s and a single nilpotent Jordan block. Fitting decomposition yields q^{n-1-s+j} entrance counts and universal last-shell probability 1-1/q. Path on 2^k vertices has f_{n-1}(z)=z^{n-1} and star gives idempotent M, so sharp opposite lengths. Confirmed 220 independent exact small-tree characteristic-polynomial/forest calculations. No inference from finite samples.
